integrity_note: The proof is an elementary independent calculation. Only the positive-rank strata are proposed as an additional finding; prior one-idempotent results and possible commuting-pair corollaries are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Counts ordered pairs, not conjugacy classes; the incidence poset has exactly two minimal and m maximal elements.
An exhaustive literature search and independent mathematical audit have not been performed; specialized idempotent-commutator enumeration could imply the result.
The direct checker uses prime fields only; the algebraic proof covers all finite fields.
title: The commutator-rank census of idempotent pairs in two-by-many incidence algebras
